sources.label: authored-in-recovery
sources.note: the diagnostic contract types and positionAt MOVED here from @obinexusltd/obix-compiler-parser (Phase 1 - 3) and from @obinexusltd/obix-compiler-sfc (SourcePosition, SourceRange) without a change of meaning — the diagnostics of every stage are byte-identical to the golden taken before the move (tests/vuets/golden/diagnostics.json); the validators (checkDiagnostic, checkStageResult), the constant tables, the tests and the README are new. No Vue code was copied and the package imports nothing but its own modules.

notes: The contract is frontend-neutral: a diagnostic says where, what and how bad, in OBIX words; what an upstream compiler said is metadata (D-50). It is the vocabulary every stage and every later frontend (Vue, React) reports in.
The corpus behind the golden is tests/corpus/vuets (pairs of byte-identical .vue / .obix fixtures).
